thread:
Maya Sales: Handing off Aurora Health (mid-market, annual ~$52k). Contract signed; target go-live in 3 weeks. Key asks: SSO via SAML, Private deployment in eu-west-1 (VPC peering), Dedicated inference with autoscale to handle 100 rps bursts. They noted a strict compliance checklist and will need monthly audit logs. Renewal window is 11 months — flagged medium if onboarding >30 days late.
Ravi CSM: Thanks @Maya. I'll lead onboarding and runbook. @Noah please pick up infra tickets; @Priya will own support docs & SLAs.
Noah CS-Eng: Creating ENG-22011. Need: (1) sample traffic profile (chat vs single-turn), (2) average tokens in/out, (3) whether they will use streaming.
Maya Sales: Providing quick profile: chat-heavy (~70%), avg input 280 tokens, avg output 900 tokens, majority are multi-turn with prefix reuse. They want streaming enabled for UX.
Alex SE: For Dedicated sizing I recommend baseline for 120 rps headroom and KV cache enabled. Question: acceptable quantization?
Maya Sales: They prefer no loss to generation quality; will allow 8-bit if validated on their evals.
Priya Support: I'll prep runbook sections: on-call rotation, SSO failure triage, VPC peering checklist, audit log retrieval. Who is their primary technical contact?
Maya Sales: Primary POC: "Leah (Aurora SRE)" leah@aurora.health. Also CC compliance lead.
Noah CS-Eng: Noted POC. Adding observability requirements: per-request token-cost, p99 latency by route, and model drift alerts tied to weekly eval runs. Will add to ENG-22011.
Ravi CSM: Renewal risk mitigation: setting weekly progress checkpoints; if onboarding milestones slip by >7 days twice, escalate to AM + Sales Director. I'll add health card with 'onboarding timeline' and 'audit readiness' fields.
Alex SE: I'll produce a short test plan: validation on seed prompts, end-to-end streaming stability, and quant check. Need their sanitized prompt set and sample auth config.
Maya Sales: I'll deliver sanitized prompts and Leah contact tonight.
Priya Support: Drafting runbook now; will include escalation matrix and known errors template. Will also ask legal for retention requirements for audit logs.
Noah CS-Eng: Quick ops note: marking rollout strategy as canary with autoscale policy; if Dedicated can't meet p99 targets, fallback to hosted low-latency cluster in eu-west-1.
ops-bot: Scheduled infra-provision job: aurora-dedicated-eu; start=2025-01-05T09:00:00Z; est-duration=3h.
Ravi CSM: Summary actions: Maya -> deliver prompts + Leah contact (today); Noah -> ENG-22011 updates + perf baseline (EOD); Alex -> sizing doc + test plan (48h); Priya -> support runbook draft (72h). I'll host a kickoff meeting Wed 10am CET.
Maya Sales: Thanks all — looping in Leah once artifacts are ready.
Noah CS-Eng: Adding ticket note: escalation=oncall-eng, label=customer:aurora.
Priya Support: Please tag me when infra job completes so I can run through restore & onboarding runbook.
Ravi CSM: Closing handover thread; will repost status each Friday until go-live. :white_check_mark:
